|game_text=Deploy on a Dagobah site. Target a mentor here. Also, target or deploy (regardless of location deployment restrictions) an apprentice here. Attempt when targets are present at the beginning of your control phase. Draw training destiny. If destiny + apprentice's ability > 12, test completed: Place on apprentice. All opponent's Force drain bonuses everywhere are ignored. Mentor: Your character of ability > 2. Apprentice: Your non-droid, non-Jedi character of lesser ability than mentor. Each time you complete any Jedi Test, you may exchange one card in hand for one Jedi Test in your Lost Pile.

|rulings=* May be used to deploy an apprentice to [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] (ignoring [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] rules).
* If [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]] returns either [[Great Warrior]] or the apprentice deployed by [[Great Warrior]], both cards are returned to hand together.
* Only cancels Force drain bonuses that come from DS cards affecting DS Force drains.
* For example, if DS Force drains at the LS system [[Tibrin]], the +1 bonus in [[Tibrin]]'s game text is not canceled because it is a LS card.
* For example, if LS Force drains at the DS site [[Cloud City: Interrogation Room]], the +1 bonus in the site's game text is not canceled because it is a LS Force drain.
